text: Implemented transform-independent patch preparation in reframe4s-flashalign. Production configuration enforces a 10,000-30,000 candidate target (default 20,000), bounded deterministic lattice screening, 12 mm default world cells and bounded per-cell queues. PhysicalStencil3 constructs exactly 27 shared {-d,0,+d}^3 world-mm offsets; offsets are converted through the full frame-to-index linear map for sampling. Prepared patches retain their canonical SupportAwarePyramidLevel3 owner, center identity, exact-bit world-point keys, source-only contrast/support quality and one-time Double normalization. No sign/foreground threshold or nonspatial selection exists. Diagnostics record geometry/support/contrast/quota rejection, stride, occupied cells and budget shortfall. Evidence: Flashalign JVM 22/22 and JS 22/22. Tests cover exact stencil cardinality, reflected/sheared signed-negative data, bitwise determinism, centered/unit coefficients at 2e-14, world-cell quotas, thin slabs, partial support, constant low contrast, extent-1 typed rejection and configuration bounds. Ownership 1131 unique names/64 canonical; diff check clean. This is preparation correctness evidence, not MRI accuracy or runtime evidence.
